Now let me copy the driver to the build environment and build with ASAN. Let me check if ASAN is available with gcc.

<｜｜DSML｜｜>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace && bash build.sh "gcc -fsanitize=address -g -O1 -I /gt/_work/src/src /tmp/test_driver.c /gt/_work/src/test/fuzzers/fuzz-mdhtml.c /gt/_work/src/src/md4c.c /gt/_work/src/src/md4c-html.c /gt/_work/src/src/entity.c -o /tmp/fuzz-mdhtml 2>&1 && echo BUILD_OK"</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
